title: Letting Logos Speak: Leveraging Multiview Representation Learning for Data-Driven Branding and Logo Design
authors: Ryan Dew; Asim Ansari; Olivier Toubia
eligible_reason: Not a DiD. Multimodal (multiview) variational autoencoder linking logo images, text and brand-personality ratings, with feature extraction and online studies.
design_notes: replication_code/code/mvae (model and benchmarks), feature_extraction (logo and text processing, Python/R notebooks), studies (online study analyses). No panel treatment design.
data_files: replication_code/data/*.csv (logo features, text, BAV-style brand-personality ratings, industry codes)
data_files_note: Processed model inputs and raw feature extractions shipped.
data_provenance_note: Model inputs as used by the authors.
screener_notes: No article text or PDF available locally (data/text/mksc and papers/mksc checked Nov 2); the OpenAlex abstract in data/frame/mksc.jsonl is a one-sentence summary. Design read from the README and the main-results code; no package code was run.
